samples.rationale: VetController.java keeps the change at the right layer: blank-to-absent normalization (asAbsentWhenBlank) is binding, not a business rule, and matching moves into VetRepository as a derived query with cache impact noted in its javadoc; the duplicated if/else query selection across both handlers and the cryptic th:with="specialtyParam=${specialty == null ? {} : {specialty}}" are the only structural smells. Tests are behavior-named (theSpecialtyFilterShouldMatchTheWholeNameIgnoringCase), use named constants and the existing helen() factory, and cover case, prefix, blank, unheld, and paging; deductions for class-level meaningful constants (LEARY, DOUGLAS_ID) that the placement rule puts method-level, and for linkCount asserting raw escaped HTML ("&specialty=oral%20%26%20dental"), plus hasSize(2) over whole-object comparison. Documentation is complete: ADR, narrowed NG-9, REQ-VET-003/004, superseded note, and the stale known-defect row removed.

Filtering lands in the right layers: a derived `findDistinctBySpecialtiesNameIgnoreCase` on `VetRepository` (two overloads, documented as uncached) and blank-to-absent normalization in `VetController.asAbsentWhenBlank`, which the catalog's Web controller row expressly calls binding, not a business rule; no new types or rules sneak in. The near-identical null-check branches in `findPaginated` and `showResourcesVetList`, and the cryptic `${specialty == null ? {} : {specialty}}` trick in vetList.html, are the two things a reviewer would question. Tests follow the BDD naming school throughout, name every value (RADIOLOGY_PREFIX, LINKS_TO_LAST_PAGE), extract `linkCount`, and reuse the test-owned `helen()` factory, but lean on the tolerated `@MockitoBean` repository stub and on bare `hasSize(2)`/`length()==2` tied to @BeforeEach setup. Docs move everywhere the change touches: narrowing ADR plus index row, NG-9 and its preamble, fresh REQ-VET-003/004 with the withdrawn id preserved, superseded entry, open questions, overview, contracts table, security inputs/outputs, and the now-false known-defect row deleted.

Filtering lands in the repository (`findDistinctBySpecialtiesNameIgnoreCase`), blank normalization stays binding in `VetController.asAbsentWhenBlank`, and the template's URL building replaces the old `?page=__${i}__` preprocessing hack idiomatically — right layers, no new controller rule, and the uncached request-keyed query is justified in the javadoc. Maintainability dings: the `if (specialtyName == null)` branch is duplicated in both handlers, and `th:with="specialtyParam=${specialty == null ? {} : {specialty}}"` relies on an unexplained empty-list idiom to omit the parameter. Tests name behavior well and constant-ize data, but new `VetControllerTests` cases extend Mockito stubbing without recording the sanctioned exception, lean on the shared `setup()` for `hasSize(2)`, and `linkCount("...&specialty=...", 3)` asserts rendered markup counts. Docs are thorough: ADR, narrowed NG-9, REQ-VET-003/004, superseded note, contracts and defect table all current.
